skillset.skill: 50s CT - 12000% Light DMG (Physical). If user is Light, reduce enemies' DMG resistance by 20% for 10s. If user is Light and above 80% HP, reduce enemies' DMG resistance by 35% instead.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Goddess Celia, increase own DMG and Skill CT Speed by 30%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
